title: Three.js Towers
concept: Ardra Lights: three procedural lighthouses (a curved granite rock tower, a banded cast-iron octagon, a harbour light with keeper's cottage) built from one kit of parts, each assembling behind a rising clip plane with cut caps, scaffolding a lift ahead, staged captions, and a lantern that lights on completion.
notes: No mesh files: face/box/prismN/ring/lathe/roofPoint builders, merged by material (17–33 draw calls, shown live). Light switcher, scaffold toggle, opt-in WebAudio (stage knocks and a foghorn), keyboard-scrubbable timeline, drag to orbit. ?shot freezes the build at 60 %; ?light=iron|harbour&u=0..1 pick a state. Reduced motion starts on the finished, lit tower with static beams.
